title: Fail-closed reachability classification under partial observability
decision_rule: Classify RECOVERABLE only if every latent state still compatible with the evidence reaches H>=threshold under the declared actuator; classify NONRECOVERABLE only if none do; otherwise UNKNOWN.

known_answer.observation: H0 alone cannot distinguish the two candidates

invariant_candidates: Observation uncertainty must propagate into reachability uncertainty
Probe value is decision-dependent, not merely descriptive
boundary: This validates a decision rule inside the frozen synthetic model. It does not classify any real person's hair follicles.
